class.name: CCoreActiveScene
class.brief_description: libprge core active scene node class
class.description: core active scene node class use for current active scene/level only there should be only one of this node under "/root" node

constants.constant: current scene is for undefined behaviour implementation
current scene is for initialize behaviour implementation
current scene is for menu behaviour implementation
current scene is for configuration behaviour implementation
current scene is for gameplay behaviour implementation
current scene is for gameplay test behaviour implementation
current scene is for gameplay multiplayer behaviour implementation
current scene is for gameplay multiplayer server behaviour implementation (as dedicated server)
current scene is for error or fail behaviour implementation
current scene dimension is for undefined
current scene dimension is for 2D game
current scene dimension is for 3D game
current scene dimension is for mix game 2D and 3D
